item.title: Browse and edit
item.description:
Library in the jump list, @library, or Cmd+Shift+L (Ctrl+Shift+L on Windows and Linux) lists everything saved: MCP servers, API connections, endpoints, OpenAI connections, SSH connections (Pro), and collections. SSH rows also have Connect.

Filter by name or by kind. The counts on the chips are what is on this machine.

item.title: Share a file
item.description:
The Library import menu is the front door. Save dialogs start in Downloads. Files are written with owner-only permissions.

File Holds Secret
.aitcol Collections, and optionally the endpoints and API connections those lines use, plus chosen MCP servers A bundle that includes secrets is always encrypted. A plain collections file can be encrypted too. The preview flags lines that look like they contain secrets and can mask them
.aitmcp MCP servers only, including environment and customer ids Always encrypted. Password at least 12 characters, not stored
.aitapi The ticked endpoints and the API connections they use Encrypted, and the secret is inside. OpenAI connections stay behind. Password at least 12 characters, not a common password, not one character repeated
.aitbak Settings, environments, customers, theme, collections, MCP servers, API connections, endpoints, OpenAI connections, and SSH connections, including secrets Always encrypted

Older .aitmcp and .aitapi files still import. An older file may have no environment id or customer id. The names and colours stay in Settings on this computer.
